## Decision

For this cutover gw ledger reads and writes .groundwork/runs/<session>.json, not the .groundwork/next parallel tracker it targets today. The store move to .groundwork/next is a later wave.

## Rationale

Verified in source: src/gw/cli/commands/ledger.ts pins TRACKER=.groundwork/next while hooks/ledger.mjs writes .groundwork/runs/<session>.json. Documenting gw ledger as the default while the registered legacy hooks/stop-gate.mjs still reads .groundwork/runs would leave the gate reading an empty store and passing vacuously - the exact D6 failure mode. src/gw/hook/stop-gate.ts already reads next-layout first with a legacy fallback, so it tolerates either choice; bin/ledger and the legacy stop-gate do not.

## Alternatives Considered

- Move the store to .groundwork/next in the same wave and rewire the Stop hook atomically
- Leave gw ledger on .groundwork/next and document both CLIs as non-interchangeable
